Name: (CP) Cider Press
Author: yourdorkbrains
Description:
Machine using content patcher to make different fruit ciders, compaitble with any custom fruit with tags "category_fruits" or "fruit_item"

You need to have 4 of the same fruit and you will get a fruit flavored cider. You can also put cider into the keg to turn it into hard cider. It will lose the name of the fruit but will have the same color label as it did on the regular fruit cider. You can also age the hard cider in a cask. 

You can buy it from Robin's shop or craft it at farm level 5.


The price modifiers were diffucult to do so I hope this explains it for you, I thank [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/114018673]Aimon111[/url] for really helping me with this part! <3
[quote]When you put 4 of the same fruit in Cider Press, the cider bottler price will be 300 x 1.5 from used fruit price (for example: apple costs 100g, apple cider bottle will cost 420g)

When you put cider in keg, hard cider will cost initial cider price (420 for apple cider) x 1.8 (example - apple cider price is 420g, hard apple cider price will be 756g)

When aging hard cider in cask - price modifiers apply automatically and they are similar to vanilla ones (silver apple hard cider costs 945g, gold 1134g, iridium - 1512g)[/quote][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22256?]
Extra Machine Configs[/url][/b] is required. 

All sprites/images drawn by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/114018673]Aimon111[/url], I cannot thank them enough! I really suggest you comssion them for artwork, maps and mods!

[i]*Note this mod only changes the color of the label not the juice color.. I may try that version eventually.*[/i]
